items.claim: Gage Young is the better striker on the feet compared to Stan.
items.quote: He's the better striker on the feet in my opinion.

items.claim: Gage Young is at a 6-inch reach disadvantage against Stan.
items.quote: Even though he's definitely going to be at a disadvantage here terms of the overall reach, 6in reach disadvantage.

items.claim: Stan is taking this fight on short notice as a replacement for Cody Steel.
items.quote: That's why Stan's taking this as a short notice replacement.

items.claim: Gage Young has a good chin.
items.quote: And Gay Jung, he does have a good chin, so I don't worry too much about that.

items.claim: Stan's cardio looked pretty decent based on his fight against Cedric Katam.
items.quote: I wanted to see what his cardio looked like considering he is taking this fight on short notice overall looked pretty decent.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has bad cardio and tends to death-gas after the first round.
items.quote: Jackson McVey very dangerous in the clinch in round one when he's fresh. Cardio is bad to say the least.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has three knockouts and four submissions in the very first round.
items.quote: Anytime he wins a fight, three KOs in the very first round, four subs in the very first round.
I have real concerns for the durability.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer's grappling is pretty much untested.
Elise Reed's record to submissions is 0 and 2.
items.quote: Her record to the sub is 0 and2.
